senses: A man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.7.10; son of: Bilhan (H1092H); brother of: Jeush (H3266H), Benjamin (H1144H), Ehud (H0164H), Chenaanah (H3668H), Zethan (H2133) and Tarshish (H8659I) § Ahishahar = "my brother is dawn" or "brother of the dawn" a Benjamite

H0305.root: or אַחֲלֵי; prob from [[w:H0253]] and a variation of [[w:H3863]]

H0309.strongs: to loiter (i.e. be behind); by implication to procrastinate

H0319.strongs: the last or end, hence, the future; also posterity

human being, person (in contrast to God)
